blind.description: A stylized cartoon apple tree. It features a twisted, stylized brown wooden trunk with flared root-like base spurs resting directly on the ground. Several thick branches spread outwards and upwards, supporting rounded clusters of stylized layered green leaf planes or leaf cards. Numerous bright red spherical apples are nestled within the foliage clusters. The geometry is solid and stylized, with painted/hand-painted textures simulating wood grain and leaf highlights.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as an irregular, rounded, bushy clump of green foliage with numerous red apples visible peeking through around the perimeter and top, casting an elongated shadow towards the top-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 5.5 to 6 ft tall), with a foliage canopy diameter of approximately 5 to 6 ft.
